home.title: Spacekeepers
home.objective: Build your Mars base. Keep your crew safe and fed. Get ready for space storms.
top.honesty: Real NASA records. Simple outpost model.

building.batt.about: Costs {parts} parts. Stores up to {storage} spare power for later.
building.o2.about: Costs {parts} parts. Uses {power} power. Makes {air} air a day.

building.mine.about: Costs {parts} parts. Uses {power} power. Makes {water} water a day. Build it on ice.
building.dig.about: Costs {parts} parts. Uses {power} power. Makes {soil} soil a day. Build it on rock.

building.pad.about: The supply rocket lands here. It cannot be moved.
building.shelter.about: Costs {soil} soil. Covers one tile with regolith. This blocks radiation. Drag across buildings to cover many at once.

build.lockedTap: Finish this goal to unlock it: {goal}
reason.locked: Finish a goal to unlock this.

goal.label: Your next goal
